physical_ceiling_notes.rtx_pro_5000_decode_short: 384-bit GDDR7 (1,227.6 GB/s measured 1 GiB uint4 streaming ceiling); 3.74 GB/tok lossless weights -> 220.8-221.0 tok/s (839.2 GB/s whole-step effective, unembed at 1,226.8 GB/s = 99.93%). Initial P0=220 cleared; marked P4.
physical_ceiling_notes.rtx_pro_5000_spec_avg: v0.10.0 DFlash 2 Q4 block-diffusion drafter (0.89 ms/draft) + 9-kernel 0-ULP Verify suite (grid-stride R8 GEMMs, fused Wo*Conv4, 32-CTA argmax) cleared the final initial Basalt P0=310 at 310.83 tok/s on RTX PRO 5000 (conv 286.3 / struct 349.3 / prose 296.8) and P0=210 at 239.0 tok/s on RTX PRO 4500 (+15.0% vs v0.9.0); ratcheted to P1 (+15%: 357 / 242).
physical_ceiling_notes.rtx_pro_4500_200w_cap: nvidia-smi dmon under 100% SM prefill confirms hard 200.00 W VBIOS cap (86 C, 2,242-2,355 MHz across 80 SMs) vs RTX PRO 5000 (348 W, 56 C, 2,531 MHz across 110 SMs) -> physical silicon compute ratio (80*2242)/(110*2531) = 0.644-0.677, matching measured prefill ratios (9,518/14,243 = 0.668 at 16K; 6,295/9,193 = 0.685 at 128K). Issue #78's initial 11,500/7,600 estimate omitted the 200W cap; preserved untouched in initial_basalt_targets while skus guards ~99% of measured P4 medians.
